content:
marta: Customer 'MarketPulse' requesting temporary quota uplift x10 for 48h — launch tomorrow. Ticket #Q-UP-982. Sales asking for fast review.

devon: From sales: cc @julia @samir. Contract signed but the spike looks unusual. Can we do conditional uplift?

julia: What's the requested RPS and token cap? Need fraud signoff + billing verification before we change quotas.

marta: Requested: 10k RPS, ~5M tokens/day. Origin IPs: 34.23.12.11, 34.23.12.12. Payment on file but card updated last week. Support uploaded a launch deck. Multiple API keys seen.

samir: I'll run fraud checks. Please paste a short usage sample and recent auth logs here.

marta: sample logs pasted:
```
2024-02-14 12:03:22 auth ok uid=mp-111 req=gen tokens=1200 region=us-west
2024-02-14 12:03:24 auth ok uid=mp-111 req=embed tokens=800
2024-02-14 12:04:01 auth ok uid=mp-222 req=gen tokens=600 region=us-west
```
Also notes: they created 3 keys in last 48h.

samir: Flags: multiple keys + new card + high burst. Recommend safe path: temp uplift with guardrails — 48h max, per-key rate cap 5k RPS, active quota monitor + auto-rollback if anomaly >30% above baseline. Product ops to provide config.

julia: Agree. Launch acceptance criteria = (1) canary run 6h with metrics green, (2) rollback automation in place, (3) legal/billing confirmation on file, (4) postmortem checklist. Who owns rollback automation?

infra-bot: Created watch ticket: rollout-watch Q-UP-982 -> watch-id 8821 (alerts enabled).

devon: Sales requests soft-approval to avoid upsetting customer. Proposal: approve 6h canary now, full 48h only if canary shows no anomalies.

samir: Canary ok from fraud side provided we restrict per-key throughput and enable token sampling. Also require signed appendix to TOS for temporary boost — legal to confirm.

marta: I'll attach appendix draft and confirm billing contact. Next steps timeline: samir completes fraud checks by 13:30, infra to stand up canary config by 14:00, product (julia) publishes guardrails + dashboard.

julia: I'll own guardrails + dashboard. SLOs to monitor: tokens/sec, error-rate, anomaly-rate (unexpected client distribution). Alert threshold: >3 critical alerts in 10m triggers auto-rollback.

devon: :thumbsup: I'll tell customer we have a guarded plan and ETA ~3h.

samir: Fraud quick update: heuristics clear so far but observed API key reuse pattern. Will hold final sign-off until canary metrics come in.

marta: Opening product-backlog item for "temporary-quota-flow" with checklist and rollout template. Will link Q-UP-982.

julia: Adding rollout guardrail tasks to the backlog item and assign to infra on-call.

marta: Putting final note here — after canary completes, we need a short postmortem and billing confirmation. If any anomaly, we rollback immediately. :white_check_mark:
